recent.text: The Red Sox have made three major additions in each of the last two offseason The only one who wasn’t an All-Star the following season was Sonny Gray, who just finished 5th in Cy Young voting Spare with the “bargain shopping” narrative
recent.author: Daniel Fox
recent.quoted_text: Nothing against Jake Bauers. Love his comeback story. If the Red Sox had earned our trust by fixing roster holes, I’d welcome him. But this front office keeps bargain shopping instead of addressing obvious needs. Arozarena and Suzuki bring proven right-handed power.

recent.quoted_text: Jake Bauers will be working with Shelley Duncan again in Boston. The new Red Sox coach was Bauers’ manager at Triple-A back in 2023.

recent.text: I think timeline is the bigger question and how the Red Sox feel about the next 2 seasons vs. maybe the next 5. Do they want to push their chips in more right now instead of crossing your fingers and hoping a top prospect dominates from Day 1? I like Arias quite a bit, but
recent.author: Tyler Milliken
recent.quoted_text: @tylermilliken_ Franklin Arias is what you do at SS? What are we doing? He dominated AAA and is the #2 prospect, he should have been called up for postseason, they could still add another OF or 2B, id consider trading Durbin/Mead too if it gets us a legit top/middle order bat
